name: Camping Resort Zugspitze
beschreibung: The prestigious 5-star Camping Resort Zugspitze enjoys a dramatic alpine setting in Ehrwald right at the base of the mighty Zugspitze peak. Open all year round, this award-winning destination combines camping independence with upscale hotel luxuries. Guests can choose from generous comfort pitches equipped with water, electricity, and television hookups or elegant chalet lodges. Outstanding leisure facilities include an expansive spa sanctuary with saunas, fitness areas, heated pools, and a natural swimming pond. Gourmet dining is available in the on-site restaurant alongside an everyday grocery store. The Tiroler Zugspitzbahn cable car and premier ski slopes are just moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Luxury 5-star camping resort in Ehrwald at the foot of the Zugspitze with spa, pool, and fine dining.
